title: Cold Environments and Antarctica
welcome_lead: Pull on your parka and explore Antarctica — coldest, windiest and driest of all continents.
meta_desc: Geography Adventure: cold environments, the Antarctic system and the Antarctic Treaty.
final_note: You have visited the white continent. Governance of Antarctica is a remarkable case of international cooperation.

walkthroughs.body_html: Antarctica holds ~70% of Earth's freshwater in its ice sheets; its 14 million km² surface is roughly 98% ice-covered. Coastal stations may exceed 0 °C in summer; the interior plateau routinely sees below -60 °C. Katabatic winds and the circumpolar current isolate the continent.

Despite extremes, the Southern Ocean is highly productive. Krill (Euphausia superba) supports whales, crabeater seals and penguins. Endemic mosses, lichens and limited terrestrial invertebrates persist. Emperor penguins endure -50 °C winters to breed on sea ice.

The 1959 Antarctic Treaty froze territorial claims, banned military activity, demilitarised the continent and committed parties to scientific cooperation. The 1991 Madrid Protocol prohibits mineral extraction (subject to review from 2048) and establishes environmental impact assessment requirements. Climate change is now the most serious threat.

mcqs.q: Why does oceanic crust subduct beneath continental crust?
options: Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
Oceanic crust subducts because the ocean pushes it down with its weight.
Oceanic crust is denser (basaltic) than continental crust (granitic), so when they collide the denser oceanic plate sinks into the mantle, forming a trench and volcanic arc.
A tipping point is when world leaders agree to act on climate change.

mcqs.q: What is a climate tipping point?
options: A threshold beyond which a system changes irreversibly into a new state — e.g. the Amazon flipping from rainforest to savanna, or Greenland's ice sheet committing to total melt.
Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
A tipping point is just when warming reaches 1.5 degrees C.
